messages:
marcos: Quick check — EU customer sent a security questionnaire due EOD tomorrow. Need short answers for: encryption (at-rest/in-transit + KMS), subprocessors for logs/metrics, logging redaction defaults, and who approves third-party access to logs. Can @ellen / @tim / @hana confirm?
ellen: I can take encryption + redaction summary. TL;DR: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256-GCM at rest. Default KMS = cloud provider KMS (customer keys supported for Dedicated/Private via BYOK/HSM). Key access is audited for SOC2 evidence.
marcos: awesome, thanks. Can you say whether we expose key IDs to customers in hosted?
ellen: We surface key metadata (ID, rotation timestamps) in the Console for Dedicated/Private with BYOK. Hosted: keys managed by us, we can provide KMS audit logs on request but not raw key material.
tim: Subprocessors (short): AWS (eu-west-1), GCP (europe-west), Managed Redis provider, Datadog (metrics), CDN provider, and our SaaS logging pipeline (vendor: log-aggregator). I will export the full subprocessor list and add SOC/ISO attestations.
hana: Logging redaction defaults: we actively redact obvious PII tokens and patterns at ingestion and in traces. Default rule set filters: email addresses, full credit card numbers (PAN), SSNs, and long bearer tokens. We keep hashed identifiers for telemetry and truncate user messages by default after 30d retention for hosted. Customers can request extra redaction rules.
marcos: can you paste the redaction config we reference in questionnaires?
hana: sure — example snippet:
```
# runtime redaction rules (example)
logs:
  redact_patterns:
    - email: '[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,}'
    - pan: '(?:\\d[ -]*?){13,19}'
    - ssn: '\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b'
  hash_fields:
    - user_id
  retention_days: 30
```
(we give the customer a conceptual snippet; do not share internal exact regex library).
ellen: Access approvals: raw log access requires an ACL membership (logs-access), a ticket in the access portal, and signoff by Security + Product Ops for customer-scoped data. For EU customers we also require a signed DPA before granting persistent access. Emergency access can be approved for 24h by @ops-lead with security notification and post-hoc audit.
security-bot: Access request #A-4821 created by marcos for acme-eu (status: pending security review).
marcos: Perfect. Tim — can you attach the subprocessor export and ISO/SOC cert links? Hana — can you DM me the one-liner on redaction coverage I can paste into the form? I’ll assemble and send to the customer.
tim: Will attach in ~30m.
hana: Sending the one-liner now: "Default ingestion pipeline redacts emails, PANs, SSNs and long session tokens; hashed identifiers used for telemetry; custom redaction rules available per-customer via support request." :thumbsup:
marcos: thanks all, closing this thread once I submit.
